summary.result: Our results would be fundamental information for understanding the potential effects of climate change on the distribution of Hedera rhombea.
summary.background: We projected the distribution of Hedera rhombea, an evergreen broad-leaved climbing plant, under current climate conditions and predicted its future distributions under global warming.
summary.method: RF (Random Forest), GBM (Generalized Boosted Model) and TSS weighted ensemble model showed higher prediction accuracies (AUC 0.95, TSS 0.80) than other SDMs.

summary_ko.background: 헤드라 라움베아는 상록 broad-leaved 덩굴식물로, 현재 기후 조건 하에서의 분포를 예측하고, 지구온난화 상황에서의 미래 분포를 예측하였다.
